guesser-build-receipts-20260823.md.title: The audit that caught it, from the build receipts
guesser-build-receipts-20260823.md.note: The section recording the first proof run and the fix.
lines: - v1 proof run (36 never-seen rows, known emails held back):
28 answers. Independent recompute straight against Reoon: 13 safe, 14 catch_all, 1 invalid.
Root cause: consolidation skipped the deep check when both validators agreed, and on
catch-all domains they always agree. Clay's native validate said mailbox_not_found on the
spot-checked pick (one picked address, sub_status mailbox_not_found, 1 credit).
- v2 fix published (Guess Status + Valid Email rebuilt; outputs re-declared because outputs
bind to column identity, not name; "Review changes → 3 changes → Publish to function").
- v2 proof re-run, same 36 rows, full delete + re-insert: 15 answers, 15/15 independently
re-verified deliverable, 0 catch-all, 0 wrong. 14/30 in-pattern exact matches to the
year-old records, 1 different-but-valid (two spellings, same person). 21 refusals:
13 catch-all domains (unverifiable by SMTP), 8 honest misses (nicknames Patricia/patti,
Peter/pete; a middle initial; a role inbox; 3 in-pattern the
validators wouldn't confirm on the day).
